summary: Camden Property Trust filed an 8-K reporting the retirement of D. Keith Oden, Executive Vice Chairman, effective August 31, 2026. Oden will remain a board member. A Separation and Release Agreement was executed with the company and subsidiary Camden Development, terminating his employment agreement. Payments representing the anticipated value of amounts he would have received in February 2027 were credited to a deferred compensation account under the non-qualified DCP. The event lacks deal terms; it is a planned executive transition with a standard separation agreement, filed under Items 1.01 and 5.02.
